name: Positive-Overlap Rooted Factor of Order 621 and Its Adjacent Repair
definition: Recover the $621$-concept block $K$ from the certified $909$-concept cut-vertex obstruction, mark its degree-two corner root $r=(2,1)$, and adjoin the specified adjacent concept $v=(6,1)$ to form $W=K\cup\{v\}$.
parameters: $K$ has $621$ concepts and dimension $25$; its canonical sections have orders $331,149,140$, with overlaps of orders $3,65$. The repaired family $W$ has $622$ concepts on the same coordinates and gains exactly the support $\{e,f,g\}$.
properties: $(K,r)$ is a rooted factor. All three sections and both overlaps peel to zero, but one side does not peel relatively to its three-concept overlap. In $W$, the vertices $r,v$ are adjacent degree-three corners and $W$ peels to $r$; deleting $v$ returns $K$ and destroys that endpoint. Deleting the third recorded cube corner instead gives a $621$-concept positive partner with the same shattered complex as $K$.
